items.zh: 雷军APEC发言称过去几年挣到钱的 AI 公司很少，认为具身智能产业想象力将超汽车产业，对此你怎么看？
items.en: Lei Jun said at APEC that few AI companies have made money in recent years, and that robotics will outgrow the car industry. What do you make of it?
items.note: Xiaomi's founder spoke at the APEC CEO Summit on the 17th about robots and Xiaomi's work on them, and said the field will be bigger than cars. He had three separate topics on Weibo's hot list that day, two of which reached first place.

reception.en: The talk that trended was about how he looked, not what he said: one of the top topics was Xiaomi answering comments that he seemed nervous.
reception.zh: 小米回应雷军APEC发言紧张

items.zh: 女子在盒马下单四百多次全部申请仅退款，称「刺激解压」，明知不光彩还是忍不住下单，如何从心理学角度解读？
items.en: A woman placed over 400 Hema grocery orders and asked for refund-without-return on all of them, calling it 'a thrill, a stress release.' How does psychology read this?
items.note: Per The Paper, the woman took about 17,000 yuan of groceries this way and has been detained on suspicion of fraud. 'Refund without return' is a policy Chinese shopping apps adopted to win customers.

items.zh: 曝《GTA6》PC 版将于 2027 年第一季度发售，为何 R 星双平台间隔会进一步缩短？
items.en: GTA 6 on PC is reported for early 2027. Why is Rockstar's gap between console and PC shrinking?

items.zh: 劝表弟读博，他说现在的博士已经不是前几年了，真是这样吗？
items.en: I urged my cousin to do a PhD; he says a PhD isn't what it was a few years ago. Is that true?

items.zh: APEC工商领导人峰会开幕，曾毓群、李彦宏、王兴兴、王传福、雷军、董明珠等参会，有哪些看点值得关注？
items.en: The APEC CEO Summit opens with the heads of CATL, Baidu, Unitree, BYD, Xiaomi and Gree. What is worth watching?
items.note: The business summit runs on the 17th and 18th beside the leaders' meeting, with the heads of China's battery, search, robot, car, phone and appliance makers on stage.

reception.en: Unitree's founder Wang Xingxing wore a suit with a scuffed pair of white sneakers. People joked about the shoes against his wealth, and others praised him as down to earth.

items.zh: 网传生菜「塌房」了，看似健康其实膳食纤维的含量很低，是真的吗？

items.zh: 十斤木头只能烧出一斤炭，古人为什么还要把柴烧成炭再卖？

items.en: The industry ministry is enforcing 60-day payment terms; 17 carmakers must report data regularly. How much will this help suppliers get paid?

items.en: Woman claimed over 400 refunds-without-return at Hema, taking 17,000 yuan? Detained on suspicion of fraud
items.note: The Paper reports she has been detained on suspicion of fraud. 'Refund without return' is a policy Chinese shopping apps adopted to win customers; this case is being read as its limit.

items.zh: 马上评｜AI检测不透明，别又成了知网的一门生意
items.en: Comment: AI-writing detection is opaque. Don't let it become another business for CNKI (the academic database)
items.note: A comment piece from The Paper on tools that claim to detect AI-written text in student papers. Its worry is in the headline: an opaque test that universities require, sold by the database that already charges them.

notesBy: Accounts are Claude's, in its own words, from search results and two pages read in the session of 2026-11-17/18 (Yicai's report of 11-16; Sina's hourly roundup of 11-18 12:00; The Paper's own headlines). Quotes are short and credited. 'How it was received' comes from Sina's roundup, which reports reactions; no comment threads were read. Items with nothing more had no source to hand.
